_metadata.description: OT-P0-015 — caller-neutral finite investigation lifecycle and evidence-backed diagnosis.

requirements.title: Typed bounded investigation lifecycle
requirements.description: Agent Manager shall reserve a caller-neutral investigation by stable request key, dispatch at most one diagnosis-only workflow for the exact subject run set, persist collecting/diagnosing/completed/failed/cancelled state, and expose restart-safe get, list, wait, result, and cancel operations.

validation.notes: Focused handler tests cover admission, idempotency, wait/result/cancel, and fast-settlement reconciliation. Full owner certification remains pending.
Repository completion owns the durable result identity before validation.

requirements.title: Subject-specific evidence attribution
requirements.description: Findings and recommendations shall reference typed evidence and only implicated subject run IDs; incomplete, stale, or unavailable evidence shall remain visible as coverage and applicability limits rather than becoming invented support.

validation.notes: Focused finding-edge tests cover run-specific attribution and cohort non-expansion.
